description: SNCF - Liste des passages à niveau is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SNCF. Liste des passages à niveau du Réseau Ferré National sur le territoire de la métropole de Tours. Ce jeu publie les données en l’état des bases à la date de publication. Une mise en qualité a été réalisée permettant une géolocalisation de plus de 90% des passages à niveaux à moins d’un mètre. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are passages à niveau, sncf, transport, train. The portal shows 48 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
